_about: Contracts: posted work. objectives: deed patterns (kind + tags, empty = any) x count; reward: character experience (stats). Three are open at a time on the stats page's CONTRACTS tab; a finished one is replaced by the next in turn.

contracts.name: Woodcutter's Errand
contracts.about: The forge needs fuel: fell three trees.

contracts.name: Hold the Line
contracts.about: Block fifteen blows and turn five with a parry.

contracts.name: Scale the Walls
contracts.about: Climb twenty metres of stone and pull over three ledges.

contracts.name: Cold Water
contracts.about: Swim forty metres in the pond.

contracts.name: Hunt the Hunter
contracts.about: There is a price on the archer. [F8]

contracts.name: Forager
contracts.about: Bring in ten things from the hills.

contracts.name: Marksman
contracts.about: Strike ten times with arrows, bolts or knives (the chest has them).

contracts.name: Arcanist
contracts.about: Land twenty spells or arts of any kind.
